# The Motivation Biohackers

> Luxury functional medicine, regenerative therapies, and longevity optimisation clinic in Malaysia. We help high-purchasing-power professionals and leaders achieve metabolic, physical, and mental balance through evidence-based, non-invasive protocols.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, philosophy, upcoming events, and consultation booking.
- [About](/about): Vision, team credentials (masters degree holders, 10+ years experience), and approach to functional medicine.
- [Past Events](/past-events): History of community health expos, webinars, and wellness initiatives.

## Services

- [PEMF Therapy](/services/pemf-therapy): Pulsed electromagnetic field therapy for cellular repair, circulation, and inflammation reduction.
- [BioAura AI](/services/bioaura-ai): Voice biomarker analysis for mental and emotional wellbeing screening.
- [Epigenetic Screening](/services/epigenetic-screening): Comprehensive analysis of gene expression, nutritional deficiencies, toxin exposure, and metabolic imbalances.
- [Personalized Nutrition](/services/personalized-nutrition): Customised meal plans, supplement guidance, and food product recommendations from certified nutritionists.
- [ReCognize](/services/recognize): Game-based cognitive assessment for early detection of memory loss and dementia risk.
